entry.sub: {{env}} · secrets and variables: what is set and how to set the rest

title: Environment setup
lead: Which secrets and variables are set, and how to set the missing ones. The console never shows or keeps their values.

sum.missingBody: Set them with one command on your computer, in the repository folder — it asks only for what is missing:
